text.2:94: Say (unto them): If the abode of the Hereafter in the providence of Allah is indeed for you alone and not for others of mankind (as ye pretend), then long for death (for ye must long for death) if ye are truthful.
text.2:95: But they will never long for it, because of that which their own hands have sent before them. Allah is aware of evil-doers.
text.3:143: And verily ye used to wish for death before ye met it (in the field). Now ye have seen it with your eyes!
text.4:32: And covet not the thing in which Allah hath made some of you excel others. Unto men a fortune from that which they have earned, and unto women a fortune from that which they have earned. (Envy not one another) but ask Allah of His bounty. Lo! Allah is ever Knower of all things.
text.62:6: Say (O Muhammad): O ye who are Jews! If ye claim that ye are favoured of Allah apart from (all) mankind, then long for death if ye are truthful.
text.62:7: But they will never long for it because of all that their own hands have sent before, and Allah is Aware of evil-doers.
